description: Send a push notification to the user's phone via their Webhooky endpoint. Use this to tell the user something finished, succeeded or failed when they are away from the screen. Pick a sound that matches the meaning: cash_register for revenue, level_up_2 for success, buzzer or error_1 for failure, notification_1 when it is merely informational. Call list_sounds for the full set.

message.description: Notification body, max 500 characters. Omit to use the endpoint's configured text.

sound.description: Sound id. Omit to use the sound configured on the endpoint.

title.description: Notification title, max 100 characters. Keep it scannable.

vibrate.description: Override the endpoint's vibration setting for this notification.

name: send_notification
